annotations.title: Find retired AI models in code

description: Scan source and config files for AI model IDs that the vendor (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Mistral, Cohere) has retired or scheduled for retirement. Exact matches only, including Bedrock, Vertex AI, LiteLLM and OpenRouter spellings. Returns each model's shutdown date, days left, the vendor's recommended replacement, the source page and the file:line locations.
